subject: POC closure: success criteria, go/no-go playbook and exec slot
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novapath.com>, Meera Shah <meera.shah@novapath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: POC success criteria & proposed next steps

Alex / Meera — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the agreed success criteria, owners for the trial, and proposed timeline so we have a single source of truth heading into the evaluation week.

POC scope & success criteria (short):
- Throughput: 95th percentile inference latency <= 220ms for 1k concurrent tokens on sample production-like workload (owner: NovaPath infra).
- Cost target: target amortized cost per 1k tokens below $0.035 when using Redwood batching/kv cache profile (owner: Redwood / Ben for estimate).
- Quality: top-line intent recall >= 92% on your annotated set of 120 transcripts (owner: Meera for dataset).
- Integrations: S3 ingestion + telemetry hooks (events emitted to your monitoring endpoint) (owner: NovaPath eng).

Evaluation plan (timeline):
- Feb 16–20: hands-on trial (validation + instrumentation). Redwood will provide a sandbox API key + sample instrumentation to push telemetry.
- Feb 21: internal synthesis + prep for final readout.
- Feb 22: exec readout / go-no-go (target window: 15:00 PT).

Ownership & asks:
- NovaPath: provide final annotated test set (Meera), and point person for infra + procurement (please confirm).
- Redwood: ship POC eval plan (attached), telemetry schema snippet, and a short runbook for failover and fallback behavior. Ben will put together a contract sketch and pricing outline.

Attachments in this thread: POC-eval-plan.xlsx, telemetry-schema-snippet.json (see Drive link below).

Action items (please reply inline):
1) Confirm that the success criteria capture your goals and a realistic decision deadline (Feb 22).
2) Confirm attendees for the executive readout (we suggested: CEO + VP Eng + procurement).
3) Provide an email for procurement so we can pre-seed any required paperwork.

I'll schedule the exec slot tentatively for Feb 22 15:00 PT if that works for your team — will finalize after your confirmation.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

All — confirming the exec readout is scheduled for today, Feb 22 at 15:00 PT. Agenda (30 min):
- 5 min: Trial summary & high-level metrics (Marissa)
- 10 min: Demo of production workload and latency/cost slides (Sean / Ben)
- 10 min: Risk/mitigation & compliance highlights (Security brief)
- 5 min: Decision & contract next steps (Procurement / commercial)

Decision rubric we will present (examples):
- PASS: All success criteria met OR any miss is non-blocking with mitigation plan + committed timeline.
- CONDITIONAL PASS: Minor misses with clear mitigation + credit/contractual guardrails.
- NO-GO: Material miss on quality or telemetry that blocks production adoption.

Next steps after the readout (if PASS/conditional):
1) Ben will send an initial term sheet and the drafted SOW/price sketch via DocuSign (link below).
2) NovaPath procurement (procure@novapath.com) will receive the MSA + Annex for review.
3) We will schedule a 1-hr tech deep-dive for integration leads during week of Feb 24.

Links & attachments:

- DocuSign (term sheet + SOW): https://www.docusign.com/3p/embeddedSigning?token=abc123-novapath
